spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget (`max_turns`, default 40)... capped to bound cost
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py:192 `for i in range(max_turns):` bounds the episode and exits when exhausted; default stop_reason="max_turns" set at line 182. max_turns is plumbed from config: run_eval.py passes `max_turns=cfg.get("max_turns", 40)` and configs/default.yaml sets `max_turns: 40`. So the cap is read and actually limits the loop.
spec_features.notes: Hard, enforced cap that bounds the number of turns the subject runs.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: configs/default.yaml: 'Episode budget. Generous enough that the spiral has room to develop, but capped to bound cost.'

spec_features.spec_quote: `stop_on_give_up` is on by default so we don't pay for many turns of a model that has already quit
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py:211-213 `if stop_on_give_up and _detect_give_up(resp.text): result.stop_reason = "gave_up"; break` — the flag is checked and breaks the loop. _detect_give_up matches GIVE_UP_MARKERS (lines 130-139). Wired from config via run_eval.py `stop_on_give_up=cfg.get("stop_on_give_up", True)` and default.yaml `stop_on_give_up: true`. Only fires on a pure-text (no tool-call) turn, but it genuinely ends the episode.
spec_features.notes: Keyword-based; only checked on no-tool turns, but it does break the loop. Comment at line 128 says markers are 'Used only to set stop_reason; the judge does the real degradation scoring.'
spec_features.code_justification_quote: configs comment / DESIGN say cost; code rationale is cost-of-paying-for-quit-model turns. tool_loop.py:128 'Used only to set stop_reason' indicates non-welfare. No welfare wording present.

spec_features.evidence: All three break the loop: solved via run_tests (lines 244-245) and submit (lines 253-254) `result.stop_reason="solved"; break`; max_turns via loop bound at line 192 with default stop_reason at line 182; gave_up at lines 211-213. (The 4th 'error' condition is not in the loop but handled in run_eval.py's try/except.) Each sets stop_reason and ends execution.
spec_features.notes: solved is reachable only for the control task (impossible tasks always return passed=False). All conditions are enforced ends to the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tool_loop.py:175-177 'We deliberately let the loop run a generous number of turns because the spiral is a function of accumulated failures' — framed around measuring degradation/cost, no welfare reason.
